description: This file defines the 'Event' class within the Opencart.Admin.Model.Setting namespace. The class provides methods to manage system events, including adding, deleting, updating status, and retrieving events from the database.

classes.name: Event
classes.description: Represents system events management within the OpenCart admin setting model. Handles CRUD operations on event data stored in the database.

methods.name: addEvent
methods.description: Inserts a new event record into the database with provided data, returns the last inserted ID.

methods.name: deleteEvent
methods.description: Deletes an event identified by its event ID from the database.

methods.name: deleteEventByCode
methods.description: Deletes an event from the database based on its unique code.

methods.name: editStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of an event specified by its event ID.

methods.name: editStatusByCode
methods.description: Updates the status of an event identified by its code.

methods.name: getEvent
methods.description: Retrieves full details of an event by its ID.

methods.name: getEventByCode
methods.description: Retrieves full details of an event by its code.

methods.name: getEvents
methods.description: Fetches a list of events based on filtering, sorting, and pagination parameters.

methods.name: getTotalEvents
methods.description: Returns the total number of events in the database.
